front: Name the 4 goose groups that count in BC.
back: Canada and cackling (together), snow and Ross's (together), white fronted, brant (99%).

front: 5 marks of a Canada goose?
back: Black head and neck, white chinstrap, grey brown body, white under the tail, black bill and legs (80%).

front: Can you tell a gander from a goose by colour?
back: No. Sexes look alike (85%). The gander is a bit bigger (75%) and guards and leads.

front: Cackling goose bill length vs Canada goose?
back: Cackling 2.8 to 3.8 cm; Canada 4.1 to 5.8 cm (75%).

front: Is a cackling goose a young Canada goose?
back: No. It is a separate species (85%). Same bag as Canada geese: 10 a day together (99%).

front: Average weight of a cackling goose?
back: Males about 1.5 kg, females about 0.95 kg (75%).

front: Canada goose weight range by race?
back: About 2.4 to 9 kg (Ducks Unlimited, 75%). Most you see: 1.35 to 5.45 kg (80%).

front: Canada goose wingspan?
back: About 90 cm to 2 m, by race (80%).

front: How many races of Canada goose does Hinterland Who's Who count?
back: 11. Four former races now form the cackling goose (80%).

front: Where did Okanagan nesting geese come from?
back: Hybrids of races introduced in the 1960s and 70s; they never learned to migrate (85%).

front: Snow goose bill mark?
back: A dark grin patch on a pink bill (80%).

front: Ross's goose vs snow goose?
back: Ross's: smaller, stubby bill, no grin patch, warty bluish base on older birds (70 to 80%).

front: All white bird, bigger than a goose, no black wing tips?
back: A swan. No open season. Never shoot (90%).

front: White fronted goose nickname and why?
back: Specklebelly: black bars on the belly (70%).

front: White fronted goose daily limit in Districts 2, 3 and 8?
back: 5 a day, 15 in possession (99%).

front: Brant: where and when can you hunt them?
back: Only MU 2-4, 1 to 10 March, 3 a day. None in Districts 3 and 8 (99%).

front: Snow and Ross's limit in Districts 3 and 8?
back: 5 a day, 15 in possession (99%).

front: District 2 snow goose limit, federal table?
back: 10 a day, not more than 5 Ross's; 5 more snow geese in MUs 2-4 and 2-5 (99%). Region 2 Rule Book: VERIFY for 2-8, take 5 to be safe (Tip).

front: BC geese taken, 2016 vs 2024?
back: 15,539 in 2016; 6,053 in 2024 (99%, Hunter Sample Survey).

front: Canada geese in North America, 1950 vs now?
back: About 1 million in 1950; more than 8 million before the fall hunt now (80%).

front: Fraser delta snow geese vs marsh capacity?
back: About 80,000 wintered in 2004 to 2005; the marsh alone feeds about 17,500 (85%).

front: What is the keel?
back: The deep breastbone that anchors the breast (flight) muscles (80%).

front: How many air sacs does a bird have?
back: 9 (85%). They pump air one way through the lungs.

front: How much of a bird's body is breathing system?
back: About one fifth, vs one twentieth in a mammal (80%).

front: Where is a goose's heart?
back: Low and forward, at the base of the neck under the keel (80%).

front: Where are the lungs?
back: Tight against the back ribs (80%).

front: Bird resting heart rate?
back: About 150 to 350 beats a minute, higher in flight (80%).

front: What does the gizzard need?
back: Grit: small stones that grind grass and grain (85%).

front: How long does grass take to pass through a goose?
back: About 1.5 hours (70%, brent geese).

front: How much grass do grazing geese digest?
back: Only 27 to 34% (70%). So they eat most of the day.

front: Do geese have a true crop?
back: Sources disagree. VERIFY.

front: Bird body temperature resting and active?
back: About 38.5°C resting, 41°C active (85%).

front: How long does a hen's spring reserve last?
back: About one month of incubation (80%).

front: Lifespan after year one?
back: Most live 10 years or more, up to about 24 (80%).

front: What share of goslings survive to fly?
back: About half (80%).

front: Best pellet zone on a close decoying goose?
back: Head and neck (Tip, 65%). Heart and lungs in the front of the body (80%).

front: Rank the goose senses.
back: Sight first, hearing second, smell a distant third (80%).

front: How far does a goose see fine detail compared with you?
back: 2.5 to 3 times farther (80%).

front: Goose blind spot?
back: Narrow, behind the head; wide side vision; can see its own bill tip (90%).

front: How many cone types: goose vs you?
Top two things that flare geese?
back: Movement and shine: a face up, a gun glint, frosted decoys (80% and Tip).

front: Bird hearing sweet spot?
back: 1 to 4 kHz (kilohertz), little above 10 kHz (80%).

front: Do geese smell hunters?
back: No study found. Smell is weak in waterfowl (80%). Treat the wind as a landing tool (Tip).

front: Who watches most in a flock?
back: Ganders and birds on the edges (75%).

front: Are electronic goose calls legal in BC?
back: No (99%). Mouth calls and flags are fine (95%).

front: The 5 steps of the alarm ladder?
back: Feeding, heads up, tall necks and honks, head toss, flush (Tip; head toss 80%).

front: What does head tossing mean?
back: The preflight signal: they are about to fly (80%).

front: Who gets a family into the air fastest?
back: The gander (80%, Raveling 1969).

front: What did GPS geese do on hunt days in Pennsylvania?
back: Stayed on the area, moved less, flew when a threat got close (80%).

front: How long do young geese stay with parents?
back: A full year (80%).

front: When do geese pair and first nest?
back: Pair in year 2, usually for life; first nest at 2 or 3 (80%).

front: Where do geese usually feed in the morning?
back: In the field they used the afternoon before (65%).

front: Same spread, same field, every hunt: what happens?
back: Local birds learn it and avoid it. Change the spread (65%).

front: Clutch size and incubation?
back: 4 to 7 eggs; 25 to 28 days, hen only (80%).

front: When do goslings fly?
back: At 6 to 9 weeks (80%).

front: How long are geese flightless in the moult?
back: 4 to 6 weeks, June into August (70%). All flight feathers drop at once.

front: When do non breeders make their moult migration?
back: Late May to early June (80%).

front: When do Arctic geese reach wintering areas?
back: October or November (75%).

front: Snow geese on the Fraser delta: when?
back: Early October; peak mid October to mid December; most to the Skagit late December to February; back mid March to mid April (80%).

front: What changes in November in the Interior?
back: High lakes freeze; birds crowd onto open valley water and the coast (75%).

front: District 3 Canada goose seasons?
back: 8 to 20 September, 1 October to 23 December, 1 to 10 March. 10 a day (99%).

front: District 3 Canada goose closed gap?
back: 21 to 30 September (99%).

front: District 2 Canada goose seasons 2026 to 2027?
back: 5 to 15 Sept, 10 Oct to 22 Nov, 19 Dec to 10 Jan, 10 Feb to 10 Mar (99%).

front: District 8 Canada goose seasons?
back: 20 Sept to 28 Nov, 20 Dec to 5 Jan, 21 Feb to 10 Mar in a non leap year (99%).

front: Clear dawn: when do the first geese leave the roost?
back: About 15 minutes before sunrise; main flight at or just after sunrise (80%).

front: How much does cloud delay the dawn flight?
back: About 15 minutes (80%).

front: Below what sunrise temperature did geese skip the dawn flight?
back: About minus 9°C (15°F) (80%).

front: Clear evening: when do geese return to the roost?
back: Between sunset and civil twilight (80%). Before sunset if cloudy.

front: Effect of a visible full moon?
back: Later evening return (80%). Night feeding: proven in barnacle geese, lore in Canada geese (Tip).

front: Does barometric pressure drive goose feeding?
back: No study found. Treat as lore (VERIFY).

front: Legal hours for geese?
back: Half an hour before sunrise to half an hour after sunset (99%).

front: Storm day goose behaviour?
back: More flying through the day; may roost in fields (80%).

front: 3 things geese need close together?
back: Safe water, open food, a clear view (80% and Tip).

front: What do geese eat in fall and winter?
back: Waste grain, stubble, pasture, green grass, winter cereal (80%).

front: Elevation where most BC Canada geese nest?
back: Below 500 m (85%).

front: Which BC MU had the most geese taken in 2024?
back: MU 2-4: 251 hunters, 1,028 geese (99%).

front: Hunting geese in Mission: extra needs?
back: Fraser Valley Special Area licence ($10) and $1,000,000 liability insurance (99%).

front: Hunt Map step 1 for geese?
back: Turn on Private land, Wetlands, Duck staging and winter waters, and WMA layers.

front: Which Hunt Map tool finds a road spot to glass a field?
back: What can I see from here (viewshed).

front: Orchards and vineyards: need consent?
back: Yes. Cultivated land needs consent (99%).

front: Canada goose track length?
back: About 10 to 12 cm, three webbed toes, middle toe longest (65%).

front: Goose dropping size and colour?
back: 5 to 10 cm tubes, finger thin, green on grass (65%).

front: What do wet, shiny green droppings tell you?
back: Fresh: geese fed here today (Tip).

front: 5 steps to find the X?
back: Glass at last light, pin where they land, let them leave, find the thickest fresh droppings with permission, plan the hide (Tip).

front: How far off the X can you set up in cover?
Best goose method for a beginner?
back: Field over decoys, with permission (Tip).

front: Decoy mix?
back: About 80% feeders, 20% heads up; actives downwind in groups of 3 to 7 (65%).

front: Where do blinds go?
back: About 9 m (10 yd) beside the landing hole, not in front of it (65%).

front: Layout blind: 4 hiding steps?
back: Right spot with wind at your back, lower it, mud and field stubble, walk out and look back (60 to 65%).

front: High birds will not drop. Trick?
back: Six decoys 45 to 55 m downwind in two groups; call and flag hard once they commit (65%).

front: The 4 basic goose sounds?
back: Honk, cluck, murmur, moan (65%).

front: Top calling mistake?
back: Calling too much (65%).

front: Can you shoot from a boat gliding after the motor is cut?
back: No. It still counts as moving (99%).

front: Pass shooting range limit for you?
back: Under 30 m best; never past 35 m (Tip).

front: Two hunters, one flock: the rule?
back: One caller, two zones, never swing past the middle (Tip).

front: Cultivated land rule?
back: No hunting without consent of the owner, lessee or occupant (99%).

front: Bait rule for geese?
back: No hunting within 400 m of bait until it has been gone 7 days (99%).

front: All round steel pellet for big Canada geese?
back: Steel BB; BBB or T for longer shots (70%).

front: Pattern standard for geese?
back: 60 pellets in a 76 cm (30 in) circle at your longest range (65%).

front: Cripple finishing shells?
back: Steel 2 or 4 at about 14 m (15 yd) (65%).

front: A hit goose sails off. What now?
back: Mark it, then kill and retrieve as soon as you can (99%).

front: What must stay on a goose until preserved?
back: A fully feathered wing or the head (99%).

front: Bird flu care when cleaning geese?
back: Gloves, clean outdoors, wash hands, skip sick birds, cook to 74°C (80%).

front: Boned breast from a big Canada goose?
back: About 1 kg (60%).

front: Giving a goose away: what is needed?
back: A label with your name, address, date, permit number and signature, or preserve it first (99%).

front: How many shells may a goose gun hold?
back: 3, magazine and chamber combined (99%).

front: Possession limit for Canada and cackling geese?
back: 30, home fridge included, until preserved (99%).
